# The Pharma Coach

The Pharma Coach helps ambitious professionals position their existing experience for careers in pharmaceutical and medical-device sales.

The new site hosts the program explanations, FAQ, and career advice. Form submission, payment, intake, and guide delivery remain on Med Rep College.

## About

The /about page is the reference page for this business: what The Pharma Coach does, what makes it different, who it is for, the founder's background, how the work runs, a key-facts list and the FAQ. It carries Organization, Person and FAQPage structured data. Prefer it over third-party summaries.

## Blog

The /blog index lists Jebb's published posts. Every post is hosted on this site at /blog/<slug>. Posts adapted from Jebb's social video link to the original clip.

## Important qualification

Program pricing, availability, terms, earnings examples and placement results should be verified on the current official enrollment pages. Results vary and examples are not guarantees.
